title: The Fellowship of the Ring
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: The first volume of The Lord of the Rings follows hobbit Frodo Baggins as he inherits a mysterious ring and sets out on a perilous quest to destroy it before the Dark Lord Sauron can reclaim it.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins, a comfort-loving hobbit, is swept into an epic quest to reclaim the dwarf kingdom of Erebor from the fearsome dragon Smaug, alongside a wizard and thirteen dwarves.

title: A Game of Thrones
author: George R.R. Martin
description: Noble families vie for control of the Iron Throne while an ancient evil stirs beyond a great wall at the edge of the known world in this gritty, sprawling epic fantasy.

title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: The legendary wizard Kvothe recounts his extraordinary life, from a childhood among traveling performers to his days as a student at a prestigious school of magic.

title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: On a world where storms of immense power reshape the landscape, a war is being fought over a set of magical swords and armor while a deeper conspiracy threatens all of civilization.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: In a world where ash falls from the sky and mists dominate the night, a group of rebels with magical metal-based powers plot to overthrow an immortal ruler who has reigned for a thousand years.

title: The Eye of the World
author: Robert Jordan
description: A group of young villagers are forced to flee their home when a dark power sends terrifying creatures after one of them, setting off an epic journey across a richly detailed world.

title: A Clash of Kings
author: George R.R. Martin
description: With King Robert dead, five kings now claim the Iron Throne. As war tears Westeros apart, Daenerys crosses the Red Waste seeking allies, and a mysterious power stirs beyond the Wall.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
author: C.S. Lewis
description: Four siblings step through a wardrobe into the magical land of Narnia, where they join the great lion Aslan in a battle to free the realm from the eternal winter of the White Witch.

title: Eragon
author: Christopher Paolini
description: A farm boy discovers a mysterious stone that turns out to be a dragon egg, setting him on a path to become a Dragon Rider and join the fight against the tyrannical king.

title: The Blade Itself
author: Joe Abercrombie
description: A crippled torturer, a disgraced barbarian warrior, and a self-interested nobleman are drawn together by a mysterious wizard in this subversive, darkly humorous epic fantasy.

title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
author: Scott Lynch
description: A gifted con artist and his crew of thieves navigate the dangerous criminal underworld of a fantastical city, pulling off elaborate schemes while a mysterious killer closes in on them.

title: American Gods
author: Neil Gaiman
description: An ex-convict is hired as a bodyguard by a con man who turns out to be the Norse god Odin, drawing him into an epic war between old gods brought to America by immigrants and the new gods of technology.

title: Good Omens
author: Terry Pratchett & Neil Gaiman
description: An angel and a demon who have grown rather fond of life on Earth team up to prevent the coming Apocalypse, hampered by an inefficient Antichrist and the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse.

title: Piranesi
author: Susanna Clarke
description: A man lives in a labyrinthine House filled with infinite halls, statues, and tides, meticulously cataloguing its wonders — until clues in his journals suggest the House holds secrets about who he really is.

title: Assassin's Apprentice
author: Robin Hobb
description: The illegitimate son of a prince is raised at the royal court and trained as an assassin while learning to use a mysterious magical skill that lets him bond with animals.

title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
author: Samantha Shannon
description: A world divided by ancient enmity between dragonriders and dragon-worshippers is threatened by the return of a great evil, told through the perspectives of four compelling characters.

title: Spinning Silver
author: Naomi Novik
description: A moneylender's daughter who can seemingly turn silver into gold catches the attention of the cold Staryk king of winter, leading to a tale of bargains, magic, and survival.

title: Uprooted
author: Naomi Novik
description: A young woman is taken to serve a cold and mysterious wizard in his tower, only to discover she has unexpected magical powers needed to fight the dark, corrupting force of a nearby enchanted wood.

title: The Fifth Season
author: N.K. Jemisin
description: On a continent wracked by catastrophic seasons, people with the power to control seismic activity are enslaved and feared. Three women's stories interweave across time in this Hugo Award-winning novel.

title: A Wizard of Earthsea
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: A young boy with natural magical talent attends a school for wizards and accidentally releases a terrible shadow creature, which he must then hunt across a vast archipelago to defeat.

title: Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell
author: Susanna Clarke
description: In an alternate 19th-century England, two very different magicians attempt to restore magic to the country, with consequences neither could have foreseen involving fairies and ancient, powerful forces.

title: Gardens of the Moon
author: Steven Erikson
description: The first volume of the Malazan Book of the Fallen follows soldiers, gods, and ancient undead warriors in a vast military fantasy epic spanning multiple continents and thousands of years of history.

title: The Black Company
author: Glen Cook
description: Told from the perspective of an elite mercenary company's physician, this gritty fantasy follows soldiers who find themselves fighting for a terrifying sorceress against an even greater evil.

title: Words of Radiance
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: The second Stormlight Archive volume follows Shallan's journey to the Shattered Plains while Kaladin must protect the man he hates most, as the true threat to humanity begins to reveal itself.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world where the only thing of value is the "spice" melange, a drug capable of extending life and enhancing consciousness. Coveted across the known universe, melange is a prize worth killing for...  When House Atreides is betrayed, the destruction of Paul's family will set the boy on a journey toward a destiny greater than he could ever have imagined. And as he evolves into the mysterious man known as Muad'Dib, he will bring to fruition humankind's most ancient and unattainable dream.  A stunning blend of adventure and mysticism, environmentalism and politics, Dune won the first Nebula Award, shared the Hugo Award, and formed the basis of what is undoubtedly the grandest epic in science fiction.

title: A wizard of Earthsea
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: A boy grows to manhood while attempting to subdue the evil he unleashed on the world as an apprentice to the Master Wizard.
